evals.prompt: Buatkan Dockerfile multi-stage minimal dan hardened untuk aplikasi Node.js 22 LTS.
evals.expected_output: 2-stage build (builder + runner) based on node:22.12.0-alpine; non-root user (uid 1001); clean package cache; pinned versions; healthcheck probe.

evals.prompt: Konfigurasikan GitHub Actions CI workflow dengan dependency caching dan parallel test sharding.
evals.expected_output: Actions workflow with actions/cache@v4 on lockfile hash; fail-fast lint step; test matrix sharding for runs exceeding 10m.

evals.prompt: Buat alert disk space dan CPU 80% untuk semua server production.
evals.expected_output: Replaces raw threshold alerting with Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate SLO alerting (P1 14.4x in 1h, P2 6x in 6h, P3 1x in 3d) to eliminate alert fatigue.
